title_original: 日本人2型糖尿病患者における経口セマグルチドの服薬実態と非順守リスク：質問票に基づいた後方視的検討
title_english: Oral semaglutide use and nonadherence risks in Japanese patients with type 2 diabetes: retrospective questionnaire study
study_population: Japanese patients with type 2 diabetes; exact sampling to verify
limits: Medication adherence article, not therapeutic recommendation; full Japanese methods and participant denominator unverified.

title_original: Pola makan, obesitas, dan frekuensi serangan pada pasien artritis gout
title_english: Dietary pattern, obesity and frequency of attacks in patients with gout arthritis
study_population: Patients with gout at three Yogyakarta hospitals; 2010–2012 setting
limits: Clinic sample and possible confounding; original Indonesian archive and study characteristics need independent full-text appraisal.

title_original: TĂNG HUYẾT ÁP VÀ CÁC YẾU TỐ LIÊN QUAN Ở HỌC SINH TRUNG HỌC CƠ SỞ TẠI TỈNH TIỀN GIANG
title_english: Hypertension and associated factors among lower-secondary students in Tiền Giang Province
study_population: Lower-secondary students in Tiền Giang province Vietnam; sampling to verify
limits: Adolescent sample cannot be generalized to adults or genetic ancestry; search result retains exact local jurisdiction.

title_original: THỰC TRẠNG KIỂM SOÁT YẾU TỐ NGUY CƠ TIM MẠCH Ở NGƯỜI BỆNH TĂNG HUYẾT ÁP ĐIỀU TRỊ NGOẠI TRÚ TẠI BỆNH VIỆN ĐA KHOA BA VÌ NĂM 2025
title_english: Cardiovascular risk-factor control in outpatients with hypertension at Ba Vì General Hospital 2025
study_population: 400 hypertension outpatients at Ba Vì General Hospital in Vietnam in 2025
limits: Single facility nonrepresentative population, comorbidity and medication confounding; no causal treatment inference.

title_original: อุบัติการณ์และปัจจัยที่สัมพันธ์กับภาวะไขมันในเลือดผิดปกติในผู้ป่วยเบาหวานชนิดที่ 2 รายใหม่: การศึกษาติดตาม 4 ปี
title_english: Incidence and factors associated with dyslipidemia among newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes patients: four-year follow-up
study_population: New type 2 diabetes cases in Thai Health Region 10 records; 2015-2017 case ascertainment and 4-year follow-up
limits: Outcome is dyslipidemia ICD E78 (not specifically high LDL or confirmed hypercholesterolemia); administrative diagnostic code limitations.

title_original: Lactose em alimentos industrializados: avaliação da disponibilidade da informação de quantidade
title_english: Lactose in processed foods: evaluation of availability of quantitative information
study_population: 1209 industrial food products and manufacturer replies in Brazil; no human clinical participants
limits: Not a lactase genotype study or lactose-intolerance outcome trial; Brazilian regulatory context 2018 could be outdated.

study_population: Narrative review by Chile-affiliated authors; no original recruited cohort
limits: Historical 2016 overview, not original Chilean patient prevalence or current diagnostic guideline; clinical assertions require updating.

title_original: Enfermedad celiaca y trastornos por consumo de alcohol: prolongación de estancias, exceso de costes y mortalidad atribuible
title_english: Celiac disease and alcohol use disorders: increased length of stay, expenditures and attributable mortality
study_population: Hospitalized adults at 87 Spanish hospitals in 2008-2010; comorbidity comparison
limits: Historical administrative cohort, selection and confounding limitations; hospital outcomes do not give individual ancestry-based risk.

study_population: Narrative scientific review; no newly recruited Brazilian patient cohort
limits: Historic genotype/population generalizations in review require separate modern appraisal; no ancestry claims imported.

title_original: Diretriz Brasileira de Dislipidemias e Prevenção da Aterosclerose – 2025
title_english: Brazilian guideline on dyslipidemia and atherosclerosis prevention 2025
study_population: Sociedade Brasileira de Cardiologia guideline for Brazilian clinical context; not one original participant sample
limits: Issued guideline, not directly validated recommendation for this educational project; evidence strength and jurisdiction must be independently reviewed.
